## Risk scoring
Use a consistent scale: likelihood 1 (rare) to 5 (almost certain), impact 1 (negligible) to 5 (critical). Risk score = likelihood × impact. This is a prioritization aid, not a guarantee.

| ID | Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Score | Existing controls | Mitigation | Owner | Due |

| R-01 | | | | | | | | |

## Categories to consider
- Security and secret exposure
- Privacy and third-party data transfer
- Accessibility barriers
- Availability and static hosting
- Dependency/supply-chain risk
- Performance and asset weight
- Legal/content accuracy
- Maintainability and migration
